scene_description: A large black cargo train car lies overturned on its side in an area with green vegetation and dirt. Several pieces of wreckage, including mangled metal and debris, are scattered near the base of the train car. Multiple pieces of heavy machinery, including yellow excavators with "VOLVO" and "CAT" branding, are positioned around the wreckage. A few figures in high-visibility clothing are visible near the equipment. In the background, there is a multi-story building complex with pink and white facades, a bridge, and a hillside covered with residential buildings and green trees under a daylight sky.<turn|>
editing_instruction: Add a group of emergency responders in high-visibility orange and yellow uniforms and hard hats positioned near the overturned train car. Place a large red and white fire truck with emergency light bars and a heavy-duty crane truck nearby. Add several yellow and white ambulances with "RESCUE" markings parked on the dirt path. Place portable floodlights and orange safety cones around the perimeter of the wreckage. Add a mobile command center trailer with antennas. Include a team of rescue workers using hydraulic cutters and heavy-duty jacks to stabilize the mangled metal. Ensure all vehicles and personnel are scaled realistically to the train car and excavators. Maintain the existing
